summary: Tested surgical improvements: waiter auto-assignment from JWT on POST /orders, per-item notes persistence, 10% service fee, KitchenPage keyboard-nav legend, OrderPage textarea (>=80px) + categories overflow-x scroll, mobile drawer logout button. All 3 backend pytest tests pass. All 4 frontend UI flows pass on desktop 1920 + mobile 375. Regression on /dashboard, /tables, /menu OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1500+ lines — should be split into modules (auth, orders, stock, recipes, reports) for maintainability.

Some console 400 errors observed during page loads (likely 400 from an auth-gated endpoint called anonymously e.g. /api/stock/risk-alerts or /api/reports for lower-privileged users). Non-blocking but should be checked to avoid noise.
Socket.IO websocket occasionally closes before connection established — polling fallback works, but consider stabilizing the WS upgrade path.

KitchenPage keyboard nav listener depends on selectedCol/selectedIdx but doesn't include updateItemStatus in deps (uses stale closure). Currently works because updateItemStatus is stable enough, but should useCallback or ref-based approach.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test table (number 999 or lower unused) created & cleaned up per test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for waiter/notes/service-fee are stable. Frontend Kitchen keyboard nav visual state (ring + '▶ Selecionado') requires open orders to demo; verified via code review + keyboard-hint DOM.
